author: musho7-dev
subject: Make every map passable through cars, not easier maps
body:
- Traction control: a wheel spinning free in the air passes its engine share to the
  wheel with grip (cars used to stall on steep walls with the rear wheel stopped)
- Ground friction raised so each car's own grip (upgrades, tires) really counts
  (Godot uses the smaller friction of two bodies; ground 1.0 capped every car at ~45 deg)
- Obstacles no longer placed on steep walls (they wedged under the car)
- New tires: Snow Chains (x1.6) and Ice Spikes (x2.4 grip on ice + snow)
- New car: Snowmobile (track + ski, x2.2 grip on ice + snow)
- Milestones are now one-time per map (saved)
- Autotest: logs wheel spin and saves a screenshot when stuck
